meta.note: Claims extracted from reviewed studies in glp1_studies_draft.json. Every number is checked against the quoted PubMed abstract by `concordance_pipeline.build_matrix verify`. Weight loss v1 scope: placebo-controlled trials in adults with obesity and without type 2 diabetes, at the highest approved obesity dose. Stomach side effects (v1): FDA label adverse-reaction tables at the highest approved obesity dose; value = average excess incidence of nausea, diarrhea and vomiting vs placebo, checked against the DailyMed label XML. Serious side effects (v1): three components with severity weights, serious adverse events from ClinicalTrials.gov results (3), gallbladder events from label Warnings (2), stopping treatment because of side effects from labels (1). Heart health: placebo-controlled cardiovascular outcome trials only; options without one stay neutral.
